title: Halloween in Rochdale 2026: parties, pumpkins and spooky events across the borough
excerpt: 39 dated Halloween listings across Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Milnrow, Littleborough, Norden and Wardle, with prices, times, age suitability, venues and booking links.
body:
From free family fun at the Town Hall and Empire to pool parties, pumpkin carving, costume competitions and late-night entertainment, here is our area-by-area guide to the spooky season.

Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October this year, but celebrations stretch across half-term and into Sunday 1 November. There are options for young children, teenagers, families and adults, including events advertised on local Facebook pages.

Find your area below. Listings run in date order within each area; events with several dates appear at their first date. Prices are the published figures available when checked. Where hours, age limits, admission charges or booking details remain unconfirmed, we say so.

This guide brings together the public 2026 announcements we could identify and check. Private groups, unadvertised parties and later announcements mean no guide can guarantee every event. Organisers can send additions to news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.

Find a plan quickly

Free family events: Town Hall, 26 October–1 November; Empire children’s party, 27 October.

Children’s parties: Rochdale RUFC, Milnrow and Littleborough cricket clubs, BizzyBees and Wardle Club. Check the age policies below.

Older children and teenagers: Younique Talent ages 7–17; Hollingworth Lake activity morning ages 8+; Monsters of Rock for accompanied ages 14+.

A party with a quiet room: Keeley B at Butterworth Hall on 30 October.

Adults: Norden workshops, Royal Toby bingo, Town Hall horror cinema and evening live music. Decadance is separately marked as an adults-only lifestyle venue.

Rochdale town centre

26 October–1 November, daily 10am–4pm

Spooktacular Half Term at Rochdale Town Hall

 | Where: Rochdale Town Hall, The Esplanade, OL16 1AZ | Who it’s for: Families | Cost: Free

Drop-in Halloween activities inside the Town Hall. No advance booking required. The detailed activity programme is still being announced; check opening times before travelling.

Official event information → — https://www.rochdaletownhall.co.uk/events/event/191/spooktacular-half-term-at-rochdale-town-hall

Tuesday 27 October, 6pm–8.30pm

Empire’s free children’s Halloween party

 | Where: Empire Rochdale, 7 Packer Street, OL16 1NJ | Who it’s for: Children and families | Cost: Free; no ticket needed

Games, face painting, Halloween music and a fancy-dress competition with prizes. The venue says to turn up in costume. A precise child age range is not stated.

Organiser’s Facebook announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/empirerochdale/videos/1092430556500653/

Saturday 31 October; exact performance time not stated in the listing checked

Mica Young: Halloween afternoon singer

 | Where: Empire Rochdale, 7 Packer Street, OL16 1NJ | Who it’s for: Unspecified | Cost: Not stated

Live soul, funk, Motown and R&B, specifically advertised by Empire as a Halloween afternoon performance. Confirm start time, admission and whether children may attend with the venue.

Venue event calendar → — https://empirerochdale.co.uk/events/

Saturday 31 October, event 7pm–10pm; film starts 8pm

Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde with live organ

 | Where: Rochdale Town Hall, The Esplanade, OL16 1AZ | Who it’s for: Adults, as described by the organiser | Cost: From £10.50 online, including 50p commission

The 1920 silent horror film with live accompaniment by Aaron Hawthorne. Fancy dress encouraged; refreshments available to buy. The Town Hall asks visitors to book by Friday 30 October.

Book through Your Trust → — https://www.yourtrustrochdale.co.uk/whats-on/events/dr-jekyll-mr-hyde-1920-with-live-organ/

Saturday 31 October; doors 7pm, show approximately 8.30pm, finish listed as 11pm

Monsters of Rock Halloween Special

 | Where: Champness Hall, Drake Street, OL16 1NZ | Who it’s for: Adults; ages 14+ may attend with an adult using the appropriate ticket | Cost: Adult £22 including fee; 1 adult + 1 child aged 14+ £33; 1 adult + 2 children aged 14+ £44

Thunder Hammer perform rock and metal tributes, with Halloween fancy dress encouraged. Predominantly standing. The page’s schedule also displays a 7.30pm event start; use the organiser’s 7pm doors guidance and check final timings. Accompanied children and adults must arrive together.

Book with the organiser → — https://www.whatsoccurrinevents.co.uk/event-details/monsters-of-rock-halloween-special-2026

Saturday 31 October, 10pm; finish not stated

Run Out The Guns: Halloween spooky special

 | Where: The Flying Horse Hotel, 37 Packer Street, OL16 1NJ | Who it’s for: Unspecified; late-night pub performance | Cost: Not stated

Folk, sea shanties and Irish music with Halloween-themed songs. Ask the venue about admission and age restrictions rather than assuming that an evening pub gig is a children’s event.

Band’s event page → — https://www.runouttheguns.com/index.php/js_events/the-flying-horse-hotel/

Rochdale: Molyneux Street

Saturday 31 October, 7pm–11pm

Rochdale Bowling Club Halloween party

 | Where: Rochdale Bowling Club, Molyneux Street, Rochdale | Who it’s for: Families; adult and child costume prizes advertised | Cost: Not stated

The club’s flyer confirms the date and 7pm start, while its post advertises extended opening until 11pm. Everyone is welcome. Ask the club whether advance tickets or an entry fee apply.

Organiser’s Facebook post and flyer → — https://www.facebook.com/61574444267751/posts/122186339276814808/

Norden

Thursday 29 October, 7pm–9pm

Pumpkin, Petals and Prosecco workshop

 | Where: Garden of Eden Norden, 679 Edenfield Road, OL11 5XE | Who it’s for: Adults | Cost: £45 per person

Seasonal floral workshop. Ten places advertised. Book online or call 01706 343142.

Book this workshop → — https://www.gardenofedenrochdale.co.uk/design-20179619/adults-pumpkin-petals-and-prosecco-workshop-29th-oct-2026.htm

Friday 30 October, 7pm–9pm

Pumpkin, Petals and Prosecco: second date

 | Where: Garden of Eden Norden, 679 Edenfield Road, OL11 5XE | Who it’s for: Adults | Cost: £45 per person

A second evening workshop, also limited to ten places. Book online or call 01706 343142.

Book this workshop → — https://www.gardenofedenrochdale.co.uk/design-20179620/adults-pumpkin-petals-and-prosecco-workshop-30th-oct-2026.htm

Saturday 31 October, 1pm–2.30pm or 3.30pm–5pm

Children’s Halloween Flowercraft

 | Where: Garden of Eden Norden, 679 Edenfield Road, OL11 5XE | Who it’s for: Children; the shop’s general flowercraft age range is 5–14, so confirm suitability when booking | Cost: £20 per child

Two sessions with a limit of 12 in each. Fancy dress optional. Choose the session when booking; phone 01706 343142 for age or supervision questions.

Choose a session and book → — https://www.gardenofedenrochdale.co.uk/design-20179618/childrens-halloween-flowercraft-workshop-31st-oct-2026.htm

Bamford

Friday 30 October, 6pm–9pm

Rochdale RUFC minis’ Halloween party

 | Where: Rochdale RUFC, Moorgate Avenue, off Bury Road, OL11 5LU | Who it’s for: U11s and below, with adults | Cost: Children £5 including food; adults free

Fancy dress encouraged. The bar will be open and additional food available to buy. The public post does not explicitly confirm whether non-member children can attend; check if you are not connected with the club.

Club’s advertised ticket page → — https://www.rrufc.org/events/halloween/

Castleton

Saturday 31 October, 7.30pm–1am on Sunday 1 November

Rochdale Mayfield ARLFC Halloween party

 | Where: Mayfield Sports Centre, Chadwick Lane, OL11 3BY | Who it’s for: Families | Cost: Adults £5; children £3; advertised family ticket £15 for 2 adults and 2 children; check checkout fees

DJ, games, food and prizes for adult and children’s costumes. Ticket-only admission, with limited capacity. Two adult and two child individual tickets total £16, so compare the family offer at checkout.

Book tickets → — https://www.skiddle.com/whats-on/Oldham/OL11-3BY/Rochdale-Mayfield-ARLFC-Halloween-Party/42806964/

Saturday 31 October, 7.30pm–11.30pm; last entry 7.30pm

Boozy Bingo Halloween Special

 | Where: Rhyddings Suite, Royal Toby Hotel, Manchester Road, OL11 3HF | Who it’s for: Adults 18+ | Cost: Ticket price not exposed in the accessible listing; confirm before booking

Bingo, dance-offs, games, rave intervals and prizes. Tickets include entry, a goody bag and all bingo games; the listing does not say that drinks are included. Direct booking on 01706 861861 or royaltobyfunctions@thedeckersgroup.com is advertised as avoiding booking fees.

Event and ticket information → — https://www.skiddle.com/whats-on/Oldham/The-Rhyddings-Suite-At-The-Royal-Toby-Hotel/Boozy-Bingo-Halloween-Special/42292642/

Heywood and Hopwood

Saturday 24 October, from 6.30pm; finish not stated

Kats Dance family Halloween fundraiser

 | Where: Hopwood Unionist Club, Manchester Road, OL10 2AP | Who it’s for: Families; children must be accompanied by an adult | Cost: From £2 in the public ticket listing; confirm ticket categories and any fees

Snacks included, with raffle entry attached to each ticket and prizes for the best-dressed child and adult.

Book through TicketSource → — https://www.ticketsource.com/Kats-Dance/halloween-party/e-ovblox

Monday 26–Friday 30 October; daily hours not confirmed

Halloween Hair & Horror Club

 | Where: Heywood Magic Market Training Rooms, Heywood | Who it’s for: Children and teenagers aged 7–17 | Cost: Not confirmed; booking page was unavailable when checked

Younique Talent advertises witches and wizards, zombies, pumpkins, Halloween glam and a Friday showcase. Activities include hair, barbering, media make-up, nails, arts, photography and fitness. Confirm daily hours, price, venue entrance and any funded places before booking. Enquiries: laurahalliwell@youniquetalent.com.

Advertised booking link → — https://younique-talent.classforkids.io/camp/5

Monday 26–Thursday 29 October, 9am–3pm; Halloween fancy dress on Thursday 29

Mr B’s Spooktacular Camp

 | Where: Hopwood Primary School, Magdala Street, Heywood, OL10 2HN | Who it’s for: Ages 5–11; separate half-day option for reception children aged 4 | Cost: £22 per full day or £80 for 4 days; reception half-day £16; 8am early drop-off £3 extra

Sports, games and spooky arts and crafts. The reception half-day hours are not specified in the post; contact the organiser. Phone 07732 865436. Select the correct age/register when booking.

Book the camp → — https://mr-b-sports.classforkids.io/

Thursday 29–Saturday 31 October; Heywood shuttles 4.55pm, 6.20pm and 7.50pm

Halloween shuttle from Heywood to the ELR Ghost Train

 | Where: Heywood station; main Ghost Train begins and ends at Bury Bolton Street | Who it’s for: Families; contains jump scares, eerie sounds and flickering lights | Cost: Shuttle return: adults £3.50, children aged 3–17 £2.50, PLUS a separately purchased Ghost Train ticket; main fare not confirmed

Shuttles connect to Bury departures at 5.30pm, 7pm and 8.30pm. Both tickets are required. The Bury experience lasts around an hour. Wheelchair and carer arrangements: 0333 3202830; the railway advertises one free carer ticket per party. This is a Heywood departure for an experience outside the borough.

Book Ghost Train and shuttle → — https://www.eastlancsrailway.org.uk/events-activities/halloween-ghost-trains/

Saturday 31 October, 3.45pm; finish not separately stated

Halloween pool party: small pool

 | Where: Heywood Sports Village, West Starkey Street, Heywood | Who it’s for: Families, subject to the venue’s swimming admissions policy | Cost: Standard ticket £5 on the booking page

Halloween floats session for the small pool. The event summary says ‘from free’, but its actual booking page lists a £5 standard ticket, so it is not listed here as a free event. Confirm supervision ratios, pool access and family-ticket total.

Check prices and book → — https://www.yourtrustrochdale.co.uk/whats-on/events/heywood-sports-village-halloween-pool-party-small-pool/book/?instance=696202

Saturday 31 October, 3.45pm–4.45pm

Halloween pool party: large pool

 | Where: Heywood Sports Village, West Starkey Street, Heywood | Who it’s for: Families, subject to the swimming admissions policy | Cost: From £5; family-ticket price not stated on the event page

One-hour Halloween floats session. The organiser describes a family ticket as two adults and two children but does not show its total in the accessible summary. Book the correct pool.

Book large-pool spaces → — https://www.yourtrustrochdale.co.uk/whats-on/events/heywood-sports-village-halloween-pool-party-large-pool/

Saturday 31 October, from 7pm; finish not stated

Heywood Cricket Club family fancy-dress party

 | Where: The Crimble, Aspinall Street, Heywood, OL10 4JE | Who it’s for: Families | Cost: Not stated in the accessible announcement

Disco and games including pass the pumpkin, dress the mummy and musical statues/chairs. Costume prizes. The club directs ticket enquiries to Catherine Smethurst on 07809 238985 or Facebook Messenger.

Club’s advertised booking link → — https://heywoodcc.clubzapevents.com/family-halloween-fancy-dress-party-01m4e70xtssj9732vhsz258rvn

Middleton and Alkrington

Monday 26–Friday 30 October, 9am–3pm; fancy-dress party Friday 30

Next Level Halloween Multi-Sports Camp

 | Where: St Anne’s Church of England Academy, Hollin Lane, Middleton, M24 6XN | Who it’s for: Reception to Year 6 | Cost: £22 per day or £95 for the full week; sibling discount advertised, amount not stated

Sports, inflatables, crafts, cake and biscuit decorating, glow-in-the-dark sports and Halloween games. Early drop-off advertised, but its time and cost are not on the flyer. Enquiries: 07565 699793.

Book with Next Level → — https://next-level-sports-coaching.classforkids.io/

Wednesday 28 October; start and finish not confirmed

Lancashire Fold children’s Halloween party

 | Where: The Lancashire Fold, 77 Kirkway, Alkrington, M24 1FL | Who it’s for: Children; exact age range unspecified | Cost: £12.50 per child; adult charges not stated

The pub advertises dancing, food and Halloween fun. Call 0161 6434198 to reserve the party and confirm hours and what the child ticket includes. Its linked online form is a table booking form, so confirm the event reservation with staff.

Organiser’s announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/lancashirefold/posts/2016944302764530/

Thursday 29 October; start and finish not confirmed

Lancashire Fold children’s Halloween party: second date

 | Where: The Lancashire Fold, 77 Kirkway, Alkrington, M24 1FL | Who it’s for: Children; exact age range unspecified | Cost: £12.50 per child; adult charges not stated

Second date for the children’s party. Call 0161 6434198 to confirm the session time and secure places.

Organiser’s announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/lancashirefold/posts/2016944302764530/

Thursday 29 October; time not confirmed

Radclyffe Arms Halloween Pumpkin Party

 | Where: The Radclyffe Arms, 390 Grimshaw Lane, Middleton Junction, M24 1GQ | Who it’s for: Unspecified in the listing checked | Cost: £15 advertised; ticket basis and inclusions not confirmed

The venue’s indexed events listing names this party and price, but the full event detail did not display when checked. Confirm age suitability, time, whether £15 is per child/person and pumpkin or food inclusions on 0161 2224172.

Venue events and enquiries → — https://www.radclyffearmsmiddletonjunction.co.uk/whats-on

Friday 30 and Saturday 31 October; children’s tours 5.30pm–6.20pm, adult scare maze 6.30pm–9pm

Middleton Scarefest: Murderess’s Maze

 | Where: Lodge Mill, Townley Street, Middleton, M24 1AT | Who it’s for: Separate children’s and adult sessions; minimum ages not stated | Cost: £5 per person per tour; Engine House party entry advertised as free

Spooky walkthroughs followed by a stronger adult scare session. Bar, food and DJ advertised for both sessions. Buy through the organiser’s Facebook page or at The Engine House at Lodge; confirm a tour slot and children’s suitability. Food and drink are not stated to be included.

Organiser’s Facebook / ticket enquiries → — https://www.facebook.com/100057627362086/posts/1547829713814593/

Saturday 31 October, 3pm–4pm

Middleton Arena Halloween pool party

 | Where: Middleton Arena, LCpl Joel Halliwell VC Way, Middleton | Who it’s for: Families, subject to swimming admissions policy | Cost: From £5; family-ticket total not shown

Halloween-themed floats session in the large pool. A family ticket covers two adults and two children; confirm its total and the required adult-to-child supervision ratio before paying.

Book large-pool spaces → — https://www.yourtrustrochdale.co.uk/whats-on/events/middleton-arena-halloween-pool-party-large-pool/

Milnrow and Newhey

Sunday 25 October, 1pm–3pm

Milnrow Cricket Club children’s party with Disco Annie

 | Where: Milnrow Cricket Club, Harbour Lane, OL16 4HF | Who it’s for: Children and families; precise age limit not stated | Cost: £6 per child; adult admission charge not stated

Music, dancing and Halloween entertainment. Fancy dress encouraged. The club’s flyer says tickets are available behind the bar and that all are welcome.

Club’s Facebook post and flyer → — https://www.facebook.com/MilnrowCC/posts/1548591573737318/

Tuesday 27 October, 10am–noon

Carve a mini pumpkin at Ebony May

 | Where: Ebony May Photography & Events, Unit 307, Albert Mill, Newhey Road, Milnrow | Who it’s for: Children; continuous parent supervision required | Cost: £12.50 per child

Pumpkin and carving kit supplied, plus a drink and sweet snack. Sharp tools are involved. The flyer’s postcode appears inconsistent with the named location; confirm the entrance/address with the organiser rather than relying on that postcode.

Choose a slot and book → — https://ebonymayphotographyandevents.shootproof.com/booking/carve-a-mini-pumpkin

Wednesday 28 October, 2pm–4pm

Carve a mini pumpkin: second session

 | Where: Ebony May Photography & Events, Unit 307, Albert Mill, Newhey Road, Milnrow | Who it’s for: Children; continuous parent supervision required | Cost: £12.50 per child

Second advertised date, including a pumpkin, kit, drink and sweet snack. Confirm the studio entrance before travelling.

Choose a slot and book → — https://ebonymayphotographyandevents.shootproof.com/booking/carve-a-mini-pumpkin

Friday 30 October, 6pm–8pm

Keeley B’s annual Halloween party

 | Where: Butterworth Hall Community Centre, New Street, Milnrow, OL16 3PQ | Who it’s for: All ages / families | Cost: £12 per child; £4 per adult

Disco, games, fancy-dress competition, pizza, prizes and goody bags. A separate calm room is reserved for children with additional needs who need a break from the busy party. Call or message 07493 913098 to book.

Organiser’s public announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/groups/2321259874849245/posts/4027682764206939/

Littleborough, Hollingworth Lake and Summit

Saturday 24 October; session hours not yet verified

Star Tree Studio Halloween Creative Fun

 | Where: The Star Tree Studio, Hare Hill Park, Littleborough; confirm exact session venue | Who it’s for: Children / families; exact ages not stated | Cost: Not confirmed

The studio’s public save-the-date announcement confirms Halloween Creative Fun returns on this date, but says more details will follow. Check the latest post or contact the studio before making plans; a booking link and session price were not given in the announcement checked.

Studio’s save-the-date announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/TheStarTreeStudio/videos/1399070621585471/

Wednesday 28 October, 9.30am–12.30pm

Halloween Paddle Spooktacular activity morning

 | Where: Hollingworth Lake Activity Centre, Littleborough | Who it’s for: Children aged 8+ | Cost: From £25

Canoe raft building, pumpkin carving, den building and team activities. Bring spare clothes, warm layers, waterproofs, wellies or shoes that can get wet, a drink and snack. Enquiries: 01706 370499.

Book the activity morning → — https://www.yourtrustrochdale.co.uk/whats-on/events/halloween-paddle-spooktacular-trick-or-treat-activity-morning-2026/

Friday 30 October, 4pm–6pm

BizzyBees Halloween party

 | Where: BizzyBees, Littleborough; confirm the current entrance/address when reserving | Who it’s for: Children and accompanying adults; exact child ages not stated | Cost: £14 per child; £1 per adult

The organiser’s flyer advertises spooky games, food, pumpkin and fancy-dress competitions and a goody bag. Message BizzyBees for tickets.

Organiser’s public post and flyer → — https://www.facebook.com/groups/2321259874849245/posts/4024249814550234/

Saturday 31 October: U12/U14 10am; U8/U10 10.10am; U16 and seniors 11am

Race You to the Summit: Halloween fell race

 | Where: The Summit Inn, Todmorden Road, Littleborough, OL15 9QX | Who it’s for: Adults and junior age categories | Cost: Adults £8 in advance or £10 on the day; under-16s free

The main route covers 4.3 miles and over 800ft of climbing. Halloween costumes encouraged, with costume prizes. This is a fell race, rather than a casual family walk; check the appropriate junior course and age-category rules.

Enter the race → — https://www.sientries.co.uk/event/race-you-to-the-summit-2026?elid=Y

Saturday 31 October, 8pm–2am on Sunday 1 November

Halloween ghost hunt at Hare Hill House

 | Where: Hare Hill House, Hare Hill Park, Hare Hill Road, Littleborough, OL15 9HE | Who it’s for: Age restriction unspecified in the booking text; confirm directly | Cost: £35 per person; currently SOLD OUT / out of stock

United in Paranormal advertises an overnight paranormal investigation. The ticket page was marked sold out when checked, despite older promotional wording inviting bookings. Ask about cancellations; do not assume that a sleepover is included, as it is not confirmed by the current ticket page.

Check availability / contact organiser → — https://unitedinparanormal.com/product/halloween-at-hare-hill-house/

Sunday 1 November, doors 4.30pm; children’s food 5.15pm; entertainment 6pm; finish 8pm

Littleborough Cricket Club children’s Halloween party

 | Where: Littleborough Cricket Club, Denhurst Road, OL15 9LD | Who it’s for: Under-11s and accompanying adults | Cost: Children £10; adults £2.50

Fancy dress, food and entertainment. Contact the club about tickets and dietary requirements: 01706 334342 or admin@littleboroughcc.co.uk.

Club’s party information → — https://www.littleboroughcc.co.uk/childrens-halloween-party/

Wardle

Saturday 31 October, 6pm–9pm

Wardle Club family Halloween party

 | Where: Wardle Club, upstairs function room, Ramsden Road, Wardle, OL12 9JU | Who it’s for: Families; non-members explicitly welcome | Cost: £6 each, child or adult

Professional children’s entertainer, music and games, with the bar open for adults. Strictly ticket-only; purchase behind the bar using cash or card. The event is upstairs: check access arrangements if stairs are a concern.

Club’s public announcement → — https://www.facebook.com/wardleclub/posts/1492211376261700/

Healey Dell

Sunday 1 November; exact start and finish not confirmed

Healey Dell Tearooms Halloween Weekend: Junior Paranormal Events appearance

 | Where: Healey Dell Heritage Centre & Tea Rooms, 121 Dell Road, Rochdale, OL12 6BG | Who it’s for: Unspecified for this 2026 appearance | Cost: Not confirmed

Junior Paranormal Events lists a Halloween Weekend appearance on this date. The current entry does not confirm its programme, admission or ages. Confirm with the tea rooms on 01706 350459 before visiting; older Halloween prices and activities should not be assumed to apply.

Participant’s dated event listing → — https://juniorparanormalevents.co.uk/festivals-and-appearances

Rochdale: Durham Street

Saturday 31 October, from 8pm; finish not stated

The Agadoo Rocky Horror Halloween Party

 | Where: Decadance, 122 Durham Street, Rochdale, OL11 1LS | Who it’s for: Adults 18+ only; adult lifestyle / swingers venue | Cost: Confirm Halloween admission directly; the club announces new standard pricing from 23 October

Rocky Horror-themed fancy dress, dancing, games and costume prizes at an adult lifestyle club. Read the venue’s entry rules before attending. The organiser says advance notice is helpful but visitors can also turn up; admission conditions apply.

Organiser’s event and entry information → — https://www.decadanceswingersclub.com/what-s-on-at-decadance/events-coming-soon/31-10-rocky-horror-halloween-party

Before you book

Check availability and the final checkout total. “From” prices may not cover every ticket type, adult accompaniment or transaction fee. Free entry does not necessarily include food, drinks or optional activities.

Ask organisers about allergies, accessible entrances, toilets, parking, seating and essential-carer admission where these are not specified. Swimming events have their own supervision rules. A quiet room at a busy party does not mean the whole event is a low-sensory session.

Already happened this month

Halloween Horrorfest, Heywood Civic — Saturday 10 October, 10am–5pm. The family-friendly event advertised traders, ghost stories, scare actors and interactive activities. It has already taken place and is not an upcoming booking option. Original event listing — https://stayhappening.com/e/halloween-horrorfest-E2ISYPVLD9D.

More announcements being checked

Rochdale Riverside and The Beach in Littleborough have Halloween promotional pages, but a sufficiently detailed current 2026 programme was not established from the material checked. Old dates have not been reused. Riverside updates — https://rochdaleriverside.com/news/spooktacular-halloween-fun/ · The Beach Halloween page — https://www.greeneking.co.uk/pubs/lancashire/beach/halloween.

An area without its own listing does not mean nothing is happening there. Further dated public announcements can be added as they are verified.

Help keep the guide useful

Running a Halloween event in the borough? Send the date, start and finish times, full venue, age suitability, prices, accessibility details and booking link to news@rochdaledaily.co.uk. Readers: tell us which event you are heading to and share your recommendations.

Sources: Linked organiser websites, venue calendars, ticket pages and public Facebook announcements, including flyers inspected directly. Details and availability checked 15 October 2026. Historical listings and events in similarly named places outside the borough have been excluded.
